---
name: speckit.clarify
description: Clarify ambiguities, edge cases, and behavior decisions
---
Identify and resolve any ambiguous requirements or edge cases in the specification:
1. Examine optional vs mandatory parameters.
2. Resolve state machine edge cases and lifecycle transitions.
3. Define handling for malformed inputs and error responses.
Save or update decisions in `specs/reminder-agent/clarify.md` and update `spec.md`.
